what: Ambient music that writes itself. Choose one of 13 moods and ALIGN builds a whole 4-track piece, always in key; AUTO keeps it growing from your own notes. A three-head SPACE TAPE echo with spring, SKY macros, and visions drawn live from the sound: cymatics, harmonograph, attractor and orrery.
author: Polaris Sound Lab
sounds: CC0: Versilian Studios VSCO-2 Community Edition and VCSL samples (piano, flute, sax, kept from Felucca); the ambient presets and the FM voice bank are own
